description.value: The Tofino Visitor Centre is the official tourism information office for the region, located on the Pacific Rim Highway near Cox Bay. It is operated by Tourism Tofino and serves as the primary resource for visitors seeking local trip planning, area maps, and guidance on activities throughout the Tofino area. For a touring cyclist arriving on the West Coast, this is a logical first stop for route information and local knowledge.
